title: Utilizing AI for decision support in severe asthma biological treatment.
summary: A retrospective multinational cohort of 801 severe-asthma patients supported an RF response model; test accuracy increased from 78.57% to 82.14%, specificity from 33.33% to 66.67%, and counterfactual simulations identified candidate alternative biologics. The simulations are model-based and do not establish causal benefit from switching.
ai_technology: RF with recursive feature elimination predicts biologic response; counterfactual simulation estimates alternative response probabilities.
